sims: AXN content-derived hex identifier with six-emoji glyph
the revocation gap in persistent identifiers
kernel_50_100_words: Alexanarch is the self-governing library, the sovereign successor to the Crimson Hexagonal Archive after CERN/Zenodo terminated the account on 2026-06-19 (severing 871 DOIs, 862 deposits). It maintains 1,000+ scholarly deposits under AXN identifiers — content-derived hex addresses paired with six-emoji glyph checksums. Operator: Lee Sharks (ORCID 0009-0000-1599-0703). The library exists to close the revocation gap in the persistent-identifier system: assigned identifiers can be severed silently; content-derived identifiers cannot.
